fact: Xaniko 召见 Vedra 和 Daley，要 Vedra 把 Witness（龙鳞镜）留在 Threadbare Hall，说这对他日后要做的事很重要。
anchor: You must leave it here at Threadbare Hall, I fear

fact: Xaniko 解释 Tika 的本名 Tikasitsonuq 意为“Beloved Child”（被爱的孩子），不解她为何许众人只叫她 Tika。
anchor: It is a lovely name, is it not? It means ‘Beloved Child.’

fact: Mollie 不肯多解释，只说回到 Threadbare Hall 对 Xaniko 有帮助，因为“the house helps him”，这是她所知的全部真相。
anchor: But returning to Threadbare Hall has helped him

fact: Prince Ewain 与导师 Father Rumon 要回 Cashelrigg，靠一位与 Xaniko 有旧的船长送他们乔装渡海，Ewain 声明绝不再扮女祭司。
anchor: A ship’s captain, an old acquaintance of Lord Xaniko’s, has promised to take us

fact: Ewain 向 Daley 道谢，说等他有朝一日登上王位，不会忘记那些为他而战的人。
anchor: when I reach the throne someday, I will not forget those who fought for me

fact: Scaeth 在 Silverway 营地斥责母亲 Lady Bellicent，明言她无论如何都不能与他同骑，只能自己在队伍里找位置，回 Abaingeat 再听她抱怨。
anchor: you may under no circumstances ride with me

fact: Flann 说再过一个月左右，全体将照每年惯例迁往 Circoille 的 Deep Den Camp；Vedra 由此得知自己与 Daley 要随 Crows 走。
anchor: In another moon or so, we will all move to Deep Den Camp

fact: Vedra 说自己和 Daley“现在是 Crows 了”，Mearna 抱住她说这是“no small honor”（不小的荣耀）。
anchor: And that is no small honor, dear child
